races.name: QuinnBet Conditional Jockeys' Training Series Mares' Handicap Hurdle (Part Of The Racing Excellence)

runners_data.name: Royal Maggs
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven fade-in-finish pattern, jockey Roisin Leech's 5lb claim helps offset this tendency but form figures show consistent late weakening

runners_data.name: It's Maisy
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with strong recent form, trainer partnership Parkinson & Smith running well lately, and solid record at this distance range

runners_data.name: Seasmoke
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent recent consistency, tongue plate headgear suggests breathing issues addressed, needs pace to develop late

runners_data.name: Pepite De Saphir
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning from 413-day layoff, Rebecca Menzies yard struggles with strike rate, but gets perfect tactical setup here

runners_data.name: Strathcatcha
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse completely outclassed on ratings, 5lb claim for Dominic Hislop insufficient to bridge quality gap despite light weight

races.paceDynamic: Pepite De Saphir will control this race from the front with no serious pace pressure, setting a measured gallop that suits her sustainable style. Royal Maggs and It's Maisy will track prominently but neither has shown any desire to press early, leaving the leader comfortable through the middle stages. With Seasmoke and Strathcatcha both hold-up horses, the lack of early pace will compress the field entering the straight. This shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace, as the soft early gallop will leave them perfectly placed to kick when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Pepite De Saphir gets an easy lead and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: Her sustainable pace style gets the perfect setup with no early pressure, allowing her to control splits and have enough left for the finish. The 413-day break becomes less relevant when she can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Maggs and It's Maisy move up to challenge the leader turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a battle between the three prominent runners, with It's Maisy's superior recent form and stronger finish giving her the edge over Pepite De Saphir's long absence. Royal Maggs fades as usual in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is truly pedestrian and the race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: Seasmoke's consistent recent form and hold-up style could be perfectly suited if the race turns into a dash, with his finishing kick proving superior to tired prominent runners. Strathcatcha lacks the class to capitalize despite similar tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Pepite De Saphir doesn't handle the return from her long break and the race fragments
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace-setters creates a messy, stop-start affair where the most recent form and fitness matters most. It's Maisy benefits from her consistency while others struggle with the tactical puzzle.

watchPoints.text: Pepite De Saphir's fitness after 413 days off - any signs of distress or hard breathing early will end her chances quickly
Royal Maggs repeating her fade pattern in the final furlong despite the weight relief from her apprentice jockey
It's Maisy's jumping rhythm - she needs to travel smoothly to capitalize on her superior recent form
The early pace development - if no horse wants to go on with Pepite De Saphir, the race could become crawling
Seasmoke's position turning for home - needs to be close enough to strike given the likely lack of genuine pace

runners_data.name: Independent Jimmy

runners_data.name: Kingston Rock

races.paceDynamic: Independent Jimmy is a non-runner, removing the sole confirmed front runner from this field. This leaves The Clonmel Kid, Hawkseye View, Kingston Rock and Quickasican all showing prominent tendencies, creating potential for a messy early pace battle. With no natural leader, the pace could become stop-start or overly competitive as multiple horses jostle for position. This tactical void and likely uneven gallop strongly favours the hold-up horses Empty Nest and Bravethewaves who can sit off the chaos and pounce late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners clash early and create an uneven pace
scenarios.body: The lack of a natural leader causes tactical confusion up front, allowing the patient riders on Empty Nest and Bravethewaves to time their challenges perfectly. The hold-up horses benefit from a truly-run finish after the early scrambling.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: The Clonmel Kid Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Clonmel Kid can assert early and control the tempo from the front
scenarios.body: Philip Kirby's charge uses his class advantage and prominent style to dictate terms without Independent Jimmy to pressure him. His superior OR of 100 and good recent form tells as the race develops into a test of stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hawkseye View Times It
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The Joel Parkinson/Sue Smith runner benefits from their recent winner's form and sits perfectly placed to strike late in a tactical affair. His recent course success at this trip gives him the edge in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If Kingston Rock or Quickasican avoid the early scramble and find clear passage
scenarios.body: The veteran campaigners use their experience to navigate the tactical minefield while the fancied runners compromise each other. Kingston Rock's light weight of 142lbs becomes a significant advantage late in the piece.

watchPoints.text: Independent Jimmy's withdrawal removes the pace angle entirely - this completely changes how the race will be run tactically
Watch for The Clonmel Kid to be sent forward early to fill the pace void, which could compromise his finishing kick
Empty Nest and Bravethewaves could get too far back if the pace becomes truly crawling without a leader
Kingston Rock's 142lbs is significantly lighter than his rivals, watch for late momentum with the weight advantage
Hawkseye View has winning form fresh in mind but may get caught up in early prominent battle without clear leader

races.paceDynamic: Camarrate will be the sole confirmed front runner and faces no early pressure from fellow leaders, allowing him to dictate a sustainable tempo through the early stages. The prominent runners Abbey Scope, Lone Star, Toby Two Scoops and Achnamara will sit tracking but are unlikely to force the pace, while the bulk of the field consists of hold-up horses including Cher Tara, National Question and Valtteri Its James who will need the race to develop. With one uncontested leader setting honest fractions and no speed battle early, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can capitalise on the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Camarrate maintains his comfortable lead and kicks clear approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace allows him to conserve energy for a decisive move, while the hold-up horses face too much ground to make up. His recent form shows effectiveness when allowed to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Abbey Scope or Lone Star can position perfectly behind Camarrate and time their challenge
scenarios.body: The honest tempo sets up perfectly for a well-positioned tracker to strike in the closing stages. Abbey Scope's trainer Nicky Richards has excellent recent form and the horse shows strong tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly sedate allowing National Question or Cher Tara to close strongly
scenarios.body: National Question's recent winning form and proven stamina could see him overcome the tactical disadvantage. The large field may create enough pace collapse to bring the closers into play.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Camarrate stops quickly and the prominent horses fail to capitalise
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where any horse with a finishing kick can benefit from the tactical chaos. The race becomes a lottery favouring those with the most recent race fitness.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Camarrate gets headed early as he has shown vulnerability when pressured in recent starts
Monitor Abbey Scope's positioning turning in as Danny McMenamin needs to time his challenge perfectly from tracking position
Check if National Question can overcome the tactical disadvantage as his recent wins suggest strong current form
Observe Toby Two Scoops despite 44-day absence as the 4-year-old carries minimal weight and has shown consistent ability
Watch for any early pace pressure on Camarrate from the prominent horses that could change the entire race dynamic

races.paceDynamic: Hello Judge will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Parisencore and Glory And Honour are likely to sit prominent in second and third, tracking the leader through the early stages. The pace should be honest but not fierce, with Special Rate and Geryville held up in rear looking to finish strongly up the home straight. This moderate gallop and lack of early pace pressure clearly favours the hold-up horses who can deliver late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Judge sets a steady pace without fierce early tempo
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the back markers to conserve energy and unleash strong late runs. Special Rate and Geryville can time their challenges perfectly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes slightly stronger than expected mid-race
scenarios.body: Parisencore and Glory And Honour can kick clear from their tracking positions before the hold-up horses get organized. Their prominent positions give them first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hello Judge Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets an easy time of it and finds extra reserves
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on soft fractions by maintaining his gallop when challenged. His recent winning form suggests he has the stamina to see out this trip from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Judge goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the last fence with all runners still in contention. The freshest horse or best turn of foot decides the outcome in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Hello Judge could get loose on the lead if no pressure applied - watch for him stealing decisive advantage
Special Rate needs the pace to develop properly - dangerous if Hello Judge sets honest fractions
Glory And Honour faces fitness test after 190-day absence despite headgear changes suggesting readiness
Geryville carries 7lb penalty for recent win but Alice Stevens' claim negates this completely
Parisencore's 69-day break could be significant but stable in excellent form with 6 winners from 7 runners

races.paceDynamic: Double Digits and Thank You Blue will clash early as both confirmed front runners, setting an honest gallop over this 2m1f trip. With only six runners, the pace won't be frantic but will be genuine throughout, as both leaders have recent wins and will want to dictate. The four hold-up horses (Bust A Move, As Fast As Wind, Inappropriate, Filibustering) will track behind in a compact group. This honest but not breakneck pace clearly favours the prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as the hold-up quartet may struggle to make up ground in a small field with limited pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The winner sustains their effort while the hold-up horses find traffic problems in the small field. Thank You Blue's recent hat-trick form or Double Digits' course experience proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too hard early and tire in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows one of the hold-up horses to sweep past, with Bust A Move or As Fast As Wind benefiting from their higher class ratings. The 125-day break may have freshened Bust A Move perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and it becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: Filibustering's recent run and tactical pace proves ideal for a finish where pure speed matters most. The compact field allows Ryan Mania to time his challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders fold dramatically and the race falls apart
scenarios.body: Multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in a messy finish where anything can happen. The lightest-weighted As Fast As Wind could capitalize on the chaos with Harry Reed's 3lb claim.

watchPoints.text: Thank You Blue and Double Digits clash early - if they go too fast they'll both stop
Bust A Move returning after 125 days off - watch for signs of fitness in the paddock
As Fast As Wind carries lightest weight - could be value if the pace collapses
Small field of six means limited room for hold-up horses to weave through
Ryan Mania on Filibustering has recent course knowledge from 12 days ago

races.paceDynamic: Dotties Promise will lead from the start with no serious pace pressure, setting a controlled gallop over this 2m4½f trip. Lost Frequencies, Executive Producer and Hashtag Queen will track prominently but none are aggressive early pacers. The modest early tempo will create a sprint finish where horses need tactical speed rather than stamina. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front-runners who can control their position and kick from the front half of the field when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dotties Promise maintains a steady tempo and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where position trumps pure ability, and horses with tactical speed benefit from controlled fractions. Front-runners and prominent racers can time their efforts perfectly from advanced positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Lost Frequencies or Executive Producer apply pressure from halfway
scenarios.body: The tempo quickens significantly in the final mile, creating a stronger test that suits horses with proven stamina reserves. This favours the classier performers who can respond to increased pace demands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays very sedate and bunches the field approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where the best turn of foot wins regardless of early position. Patient riders with horses held up can unleash devastating late kicks through gaps.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Dotties Promise stops quickly or makes jumping errors when pressured
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with horses coming from all angles in a messy finish. Any horse with tactical awareness and a willing attitude can capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Dotties Promise jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could derail the controlled pace scenario entirely
Lost Frequencies positioning in first mile - needs to avoid getting trapped behind the moderate tempo if it becomes stop-start
Diamond Koda and Port Station early positioning - both need to be handy enough to strike if the pace doesn't develop
Executive Producer handling trip extension - significant step up to 2m4½f with limited recent evidence over distance
Track conditions through card - good ground reading consistent but any changes could impact hold-up horses most
